evidence: The survivor uses "adjacency as bitsets" and checks an existing edge with "if not (row_a >> b) & 1" before intersecting neighborhoods to find the third vertex.
affordance_in_statement: A group of three individuals justifies the roster failure if, for every possible way to choose one of them to work in a different period from the other two, the two individuals who end up sharing a period always have a preliminary friction report between them.
removal_suggestion: There is no semantics-preserving rewording that removes this reduction: the stated condition is exactly that all three pairs are reported. To defeat the survivor, add a mutable nonlocal qualification, such as requiring the selected triangle not to be contained in any four-person all-reported group, while keeping the same three-integer output.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Recognizes the required group as a triangle and uses integer bitset neighborhood intersections, scanning vertices in lexicographic order.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: A group of three is valid exactly when every pair among the three has a preliminary friction report.

common_affordance: The validity condition is exactly triangle existence in an undirected simple graph, so a bitset intersection finds the answer efficiently.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It uses a dense adjacency matrix and a cubic nested loop over all ordered candidate triples, causing TLE at n = 2000.
It similarly performs exhaustive cubic triangle enumeration, despite also constructing adjacency structures, so it exceeds the time limit.
It scans candidate triples directly with adjacency-matrix lookups, giving cubic worst-case time and TLE.

recommended_edit: Change the validity rule so that an all-pairs-report triangle is necessary but not sufficient—for example, require the lexicographically smallest qualifying triangle that is not contained in any four-person set whose every pair has a report.
regression_risk: This edit could restore the already-defeated matrix-based students if the added qualification is implemented with another cubic scan; require the added property to be checked efficiently or increase its nonlocal complexity.
